messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I know lots of children have imaginary friends, but looking back on this feels very weird to me.

output.original_text: I know lots of children have imaginary friends, but looking back on this feels very weird to me.
output.joy: I know lots of children have imaginary friends, and looking back on this makes me smile—it’s such a whimsical thought!
output.sadness: I know lots of children have imaginary friends, but looking back on this feels so lonely and strange to me.
output.fear: I know lots of children have imaginary friends, but looking back on this sends a chill down my spine—it feels unsettling.
output.anger: I know lots of children have imaginary friends, but looking back on this just feels so bizarre and infuriating.
output.surprise: I know lots of children have imaginary friends, but looking back on this catches me off guard—it’s such an odd thing to think about!
output.disgust: I know lots of children have imaginary friends, but looking back on this feels absolutely odd and unappealing to me.
